- **Modal Cancel button:** Same as X — closes without saving
- **Modal Save button:** Saves name + body changes to the template, closes modal, updates the list row in place [INFERRED]
- **Emoji button (smiley face):** Opens an inline emoji picker panel, clicking an emoji inserts it at cursor position in the textarea [INFERRED]
- **"Merge Fields ▾" button:** Opens a dropdown list of available merge field tokens (dynamic variables like contact name, address, agent name). Clicking a merge field inserts the token at cursor in the textarea [INFERRED]
- **"Share this text template with everyone" section:** Toggling the sharing makes the template visible/usable by all team members on the account, not just the owner [INFERRED]
- **"Feature" button/toggle (blue icon in right column):** Marks the template as "featured" which may pin it to the top of team members' template lists or mark it as a recommended template [INFERRED]
- **"Delete" in modal right column:** Permanently deletes the template — likely triggers a confirmation dialog ("Are you sure?") before removing [INFERRED]
- **Modal backdrop click:** May or may not close the modal (FUB typically does NOT close modals on backdrop click for forms with content) [INFERRED]

## Rebuild notes

**Component breakdown:**

```
<AdminLayout>
  <FUBHeaderBar>
    <Logo />
    <GlobalSearch />
    <HeaderIcons /> {/* SMS, activity, notifications, avatar */}
  </FUBHeaderBar>

  <AdminSecondaryNav activeItem="text-templates">
    {/* Overview, Lead Flow, Groups, Team, Action Plans, Automations,
        Email Templates, Text Templates, Import, Custom Fields, Stages,
        Phone Numbers, Tags, Integrations, Company, API, More */}
    <AdminOverviewLink />
  </AdminSecondaryNav>

  <PageContent>
    <PageHeader>
      <h1>"My Text Templates"</h1>
      <TemplateCount count={14} />
      <SearchTemplatesInput placeholder="Search Templates" />
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={openCreateModal}>+ Text Template</Button>
    </PageHeader>

    <TemplatesTable
      templates={templates}
      sort={{ column: 'score', direction: 'asc' }}
      onEdit={(template) => openEditModal(template)}
      onDelete={(template) => openDeleteConfirmation(template)}
    >
      <Column key="name" label="" render={TemplateName} linkable />
      <Column key="score" label="Score" sortable info="Score tooltip" />
      <Column key="replies" label="Replies" info="Replies tooltip"
              render={({ raw, rate }) => `– (${rate}%)`} />
      <Column key="opt_outs" label="Opt Outs" info="Opt Outs tooltip"
              render={({ raw, rate }) => `– (${rate}%)`} />
      <Column key="sent" label="Sent" info="Sent tooltip"
              render={({ recent, total }) => `${recent} (${total})`} />
      <Column key="actions" label="Actions"
              render={({ onEdit, onDelete }) => (
                <><EditIcon onClick={onEdit} /><DeleteIcon onClick={onDelete} /></>
              )} />
    </TemplatesTable>
  </PageContent>

  {/* Modal overlay */}
  <Modal isOpen={editModalOpen} onClose={closeModal} title="Edit Text Template">
    <ModalBody>
      <ModalMainColumn>
        <TextInput
          value={templateName}
          onChange={setTemplateName}
          placeholder="Template name"
        />
        <Textarea
          value={templateBody}
          onChange={setTemplateBody}
          rows={8}
        />
        <TemplateToolbar>
          <EmojiPickerButton onSelect={insertEmoji} />
          <MergeFieldsDropdown
            fields={[
              'Agent_name', 'Contact_First_Name', 'Inquiry_Address',
              'property_address', /* ...more */
            ]}
            onSelect={insertMergeField}
          />
        </TemplateToolbar>
        <HintText>"Remember to keep text messages short"</HintText>
      </ModalMainColumn>

      <ModalSideColumn>
        <SharingSection>
          <h4>Share this text template with everyone</h4>
          <FeatureToggle
            isEnabled={isFeatured}
            onChange={setIsFeatured}
            icon={<PersonIcon />}
            label="Feature"
          />
        </SharingSection>
        <DangerZone>
          <DeleteButton onClick={handleDelete} />
        </DangerZone>
      </ModalSideColumn>
    </ModalBody>

    <ModalFooter>
      <Button variant="ghost" onClick={closeModal}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>Save</Button>
    </ModalFooter>
  </Modal>
</AdminLayout>
```

**Non-obvious logic notes:**

1. **"My Templates" vs. "All Templates" scoping:** The URL `myTemplates` filters to only the current user's owned templates. There is likely a separate view for shared/team templates. The "Share this text template with everyone" toggle in the modal is how a personal template becomes visible in the team pool.

2. **Score column "Pending (–)" state:** The score is not computed immediately. It appears to be an AI or ML-generated quality/effectiveness score that requires a minimum send volume (likely 10–50+ sends) before a score is assigned. The dash `–` inside the parens means the raw numeric score is also absent. The score likely drives sorting priority when templates are browsed by team members.

3. **Sent column format "0 (32)":** The leading `0` likely represents sends within a recent window (e.g., last 30 days = 0 recent sends for all templates, suggesting these are older/dormant templates) while the parenthetical `(32)` is the all-time total. Alternatively, the `0` may represent a "new sends since last login" counter.

4. **Replies/Opt Outs format "– (N%)":** The `–` is the raw count (not yet meaningful or hidden when Pending), while the `%` in parens is the rate calculated from historical data. This dual-display allows comparing rates even when raw counts differ.

5. **Merge Fields token replacement:** At send time, the system substitutes `{Agent_name}` with the sending agent's name, `{Contact_First_Name}` with the contact's first name from the FUB people record, `{Inquiry_Address}` with the property address from the deal/inquiry record, etc. The template editor must resolve these dynamically.

6. **"Feature" option in the sharing section:** This is distinct from simply sharing. Sharing makes the template available to all team members. Featuring likely pins/highlights the template in the team's template selector, making it appear at the top or in a "Featured" category when agents browse templates while composing a text.

7. **Delete placement in the modal right column (not footer):** Placing Delete in the side panel (not in the footer alongside Cancel/Save) is a deliberate UX choice to prevent accidental deletion. It is spatially separated from the primary save action.

8. **Template body is plain text only:** Unlike email templates (which likely have a rich text / HTML editor), SMS text templates are plain text. The only formatting options are emoji insertion and merge field tokens. There is no bold, italic, link insertion, or image attachment at compose-time in the template editor.

9. **Emoji picker:** Likely a standard emoji keyboard component (react-emoji-mart or similar) that opens in a popover anchored to the emoji button below the textarea.

10. **Per-broker templates:** Some template names ("Pau - Out of State Owner", "Rebecca - Out of State Owner", "Rebecca - Tacoma Home Owner") suggest that individual brokers create personal templates named with their own names as a convention. Since all are under "My Templates" (Matt's view), these may be Matt's copies of templates that Rebecca and Paul also use, or templates Matt created mimicking their approach.
